ra: Asgard is one of the nine worlds in the standard reconstruction (Gylfaginning).
Midgard, the human world, is one of the nine worlds.
Vanaheim is counted among the nine worlds in the standard scholarly list.
Jotunheim, land of the giants, is one of the nine worlds.
Niflheim is one of the nine worlds (Gylfaginning).
Muspelheim is one of the nine worlds (Gylfaginning).
Alfheim, home of the light-elves, is one of the nine worlds.
Svartalfheim/Nidavellir, realm of dwarves/dark-elves, is one of the nine worlds in the standard list.
Hel (the underworld) completes the standard nine-world enumeration; existing entity ENT_NOR_HEL conflates the ruler and her realm.
Asgard is the stronghold of the Æsir (Gylfaginning).
Odin resides in Asgard, in his hall Valhalla.
Vanaheim is the home of the Vanir (Vafþrúðnismál 39).
Jotunheim/Utgard is the land of the jötnar (Gylfaginning).
Svartalfheim/Nidavellir is the subterranean realm of the dwarves and their smithies.
Valhalla is a hall situated within Asgard (Grímnismál; Gylfaginning).
The Einherjar, the chosen slain, feast in Valhalla awaiting Ragnarök.
Valhalla is Odin's hall of the slain.
The Valkyries serve the Einherjar in Valhalla (Grímnismál; Gylfaginning).
Folkvangr is Freyja's field where she receives half the battle-slain (Grímnismál 14).
Heimdall guards Bifröst at the edge of heaven (Gylfaginning).
Ginnungagap lies between Niflheim and Muspelheim; Niflheim's rime meets it from the north (Gylfaginning).
Muspelheim's heat meets Ginnungagap from the south, generating Ymir (Gylfaginning).
Surtr stands at the frontier of Muspelheim guarding it with a flaming sword (Gylfaginning).
The Well of Urd lies beneath a root of Yggdrasil where the gods hold court (Völuspá; Gylfaginning).
The Norns dwell by the Well of Urd and water Yggdrasil from it (Völuspá 20).
The Well of Mimir lies beneath a root of Yggdrasil (Gylfaginning).
Mímir keeps the Well of Wisdom; Odin pledged his eye there (Völuspá 28; Gylfaginning).
Níðhöggr gnaws the root of Yggdrasil in Niflheim beside Hvergelmir (Gylfaginning; Grímnismál).
Jörmungandr the World Serpent encircles Midgard in the surrounding sea (Gylfaginning).
Bifröst connects Midgard to Asgard, the gods' road into heaven (Gylfaginning).
The nine worlds are bound together by the world-tree Yggdrasil, whose roots and branches reach into them.
